conservative_sampling_bounds.explanation: Finite-population hypergeometric inversion; each endpoint interval uses Bonferroni across 20 strata. The strict lower and optimistic upper together also give a conservative 95% envelope covering sampling uncertainty plus ambiguity endpoints. Wide bounds are intentional. Coverage concerns the random sample of this saved run, conditional on fixed case judgments, not run-to-run randomness or reviewer validity.

strata.label: organization based or located in
strata.definition: Organization X is based, headquartered or physically located in geographic place Y.
strata.scope_notes: Based-in, headquarters-in and geographic company/firm descriptions dominate, preserving the prior organizational-location scope. Geographic noun modifiers qualify for firms; subject-matter or industry modifiers and personal/event locations alone do not.

strata.label: managerial or organizational leader of
strata.definition: Person X holds a managerial or organizational leadership office in organization or political body Y.
strata.scope_notes: Chairman, head, executive and leader paths dominate, preserving the prior broad leadership scope. Founder, ownership and ordinary membership alone are separate relations. Party adjectives and party-labelled unnamed persons remain identity ambiguities.

strata.label: directed communication to
strata.definition: X directs an utterance, request, warning or explicit message to Y.
strata.scope_notes: Tell, urge, ask, notify and speak-to give the directed-communication component, preserving prior scope. Accusing or speaking about someone is insufficient without evidence of address. Sending an unspecified object alone is ambiguous; institutional speech through representatives is allowed.

strata.label: spokesperson for
strata.definition: Person X serves as a spokesperson or expressly speaks for person or organization Y.
strata.scope_notes: Spokesman/spokeswoman is the strongest recurring specific role and preserves the prior spokesperson predicate. This cluster also contains a substantial broader managerial/director component; those offices alone do not imply a spokesperson role, and this scope does not union them. Predicate choice is material in this mixed cluster.

strata.label: analyst at
strata.definition: Person X works as an analyst for or follows an industry or companies for organization Y.
strata.scope_notes: Analyst-at/with/for dominates, preserving the prior analyst scope. Professorship, directorship or expertise alone does not establish an analyst role; these form competing components.

strata.label: lives in
strata.definition: Person or population X resides in geographic place Y.
strata.scope_notes: Live-in dominates the coherent residence component, preserving prior scope. An explicit home or immigration/resettlement can establish residence; death or other events in a place alone cannot. Bare adjectives or malformed names do not identify a stable person automatically.

strata.label: subsidiary or organizational unit of
strata.definition: Organization X is owned by, a subsidiary of, or an organizational unit of parent Y.
strata.scope_notes: Unit-of, part-of, owned-by and subsidiary-of dominate, preserving the prior child-to-parent organizational containment predicate. Historical ownership qualifies; competition and geographical containment do not.

strata.label: winner or champion of
strata.definition: Person, team or organization X wins award or competitive title/event Y.
strata.scope_notes: Win, champion, winner and title paths define the coherent award/championship component, preserving the prior scope. Political office, organizational membership and travel are separate predicates; participation alone does not qualify. A clear win path is assessed as textual support without importing external outcome history.

strata.label: defeated opponent
strata.definition: X defeated opponent Y in a competitive contest.
strata.scope_notes: Beat, defeat, victory-over, sweep and outlast collectively define the dominant victory component, retaining the prior directional defeat scope. Lose-to and play paths are competing or weaker relations; a win remains supported despite losses on other occasions.

strata.label: managerial or organizational leader of
strata.definition: Person X holds a managerial or organizational leadership office in organization Y.
strata.scope_notes: Director and head paths dominate, preserving the prior broad managerial scope for director clusters. Departmental or research directorship qualifies; economist, lobbyist and academic roles alone do not. Inverse organization-to-president paths are separate.

strata.label: coach of
strata.definition: Person X coaches sports team or collegiate athletic program Y.
strata.scope_notes: Coach descriptions dominate, retaining the prior coach scope and direction. Historical coaching qualifies; a managerial title alone would not establish coaching, and player or institutional-membership roles remain separate.

strata.label: directed communication to
strata.definition: X directs an utterance, request, advice or explicit message to Y.
strata.scope_notes: Ask, tell, urge, persuade and address-to form the dominant communication component, preserving prior scope. Unspecified send, submit or give objects are ambiguous alone because they can be noncommunicative. Sporting player roles do not independently establish communication.

strata.label: departed from
strata.definition: Person or organization X leaves or withdraws physically from geographic place Y.
strata.scope_notes: This diffuse cluster mixes departure, arrival, legal occupation, publication and residence paths. Leave, withdraw-from, withdrawal and pull-out collectively define the selected coherent departure component. Arrival is a competing direction and residence is a different predicate; neither is unioned into it. No uniquely dominant interpretation is guaranteed, so relation-level predicate choice is a material caveat.

strata.label: owns
strata.definition: Person or organization X owns organization or asset Y.
strata.scope_notes: Own, owner, parent, company-of and acquisition paths collectively form the largest coherent ownership component, preserving the prior ownership direction. Birthplace is a prominent competing component with the two highest individual path counts; it is not unioned with ownership. Location of premises alone is insufficient and proposed/rejected acquisitions alone would be ambiguous.

strata.label: subsidiary or organizational unit of
strata.definition: Organization X is owned by, a subsidiary of, or an organizational unit of parent Y.
strata.scope_notes: Unit, part, subsidiary and owned-by define the child-to-parent containment predicate, retaining prior scope. This cluster includes many office-location attachments: a city label may be shorthand for an omitted local office, but the literal city is not the organizational unit, so those cases require identity clarification.

strata.label: has organizational or political leader
strata.definition: Organization or political body X has person Y as a leader or holder of a leadership office.
strata.scope_notes: Possessive leader/president and inverse leader appositions dominate. This is the inverse direction of the prior leadership predicate, explicitly X body to Y person. Ordinary membership, geographic co-occurrence and interaction alone do not qualify.

strata.label: politically controls
strata.definition: Political group X controls or gains control of political body Y.
strata.scope_notes: Control, take-control, retain-control, win-control and regain-control collectively define the coherent political-control component. Generic win/be-in and sporting tournament paths form competing components; they are not combined into a generic success relation. Winning control or historical control qualifies, mere presence or membership does not.

strata.label: member of
strata.definition: Person, country or organization X is or becomes a member of organization or political group Y.
strata.scope_notes: Member-of, membership, entry/accession and join provide the membership component. Joining someone in an action or alliance is distinct from becoming a constituent member; bare join without its completion can be ambiguous. Diplomatic relations, borders and television-title fragments do not establish membership.

strata.label: economist at
strata.definition: Person X is an economist affiliated with organization Y.
strata.scope_notes: Economist-at/for/with/of dominates the occupational component. Generic official, diplomat, analyst, executive or specialist roles alone do not establish economist status. Departmental affiliation and historical service qualify.
